verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Our Father in heaven,
Holy be Your name
Your Kingdom come,
Your will be done
On earth as in heaven

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Gove us today our daily bread
Forgive us our sins,
as we forgive those who sin against us

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Do not bring us to the test
But deliver us from evil

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
For the Kingdom, the power,
and the glory are Yours,
now and forever
